# Dan McComb

> > Dan McComb's filmmaking resource covering documentary production, cinematography techniques, and video editing workflows with Final Cut Pro X.

A Seattle-based filmmaker's blog featuring practical tutorials on camera equipment (Canon, Black Magic, Zoom), lighting techniques, audio recording solutions, and documentary filmmaking approaches that blend narrative fiction methods with observational storytelling.

## Key Topics

- Documentary filmmaking
- Final Cut Pro X
- Cinematography techniques
- Video production
- Audio recording (Zoom H4N, Tram TR50, Sennheiser 8060)
- Camera equipment reviews (Canon, Black Magic Cinema)
- Lighting and negative fill
- Seattle film community
- Documentary reviews and analysis
- Filmmaking on budget
- iPhone filmmaking
- Creative process
- Fiction filmmaking techniques
- Film editing workflows
- Production tools and gear

## Filmmaking Techniques & Tutorials

- [10 tips for shooting a documentary film using fiction filmmaking techniques](https://www.danmccomb.com/10-tips-for-shooting-a-documentary-film-using-fiction-techniques): Documentary filmmaking guide applying narrative fiction techniques
- [How to film an iPhone screen like a Pro](https://www.danmccomb.com/how-to-film-an-iphone-screen): Tutorial on filming iPhone screens using green screen keying in FCPX
- [Overcast lighting tip: take it off the top with negative fill](https://www.danmccomb.com/overcast-lighting-tip-take-it-off-the-top-with-negative-fill): Negative fill lighting technique for Seattle overcast conditions
- [More Final Cut Pro X editing tricks](https://www.danmccomb.com/more-final-cut-pro-x-editing-tricks): FCPX editing tips including keyboard shortcuts and timeline tricks

## Camera & Audio Equipment

- [Covid Nurse short doc tests C500mkii on front lines of the pandemic](https://www.danmccomb.com/covid-nurse-short-doc-tests-c500mkii-on-front-lines-of-the-pandemic): Canon C500mkii camera test filming COVID ICU nurse at UW Medicine
- [Black Magic BMD Cinema: A camera worth getting excited about](https://www.danmccomb.com/black-magic-bmd-cinema-a-camera-worth-getting-excited-about): Black Magic Cinema Camera review comparing pricing to Canon 5D mkiii
- [Zoom H1 as "wireless" lav = 4x cheaper](https://www.danmccomb.com/zoom-h1-as-wireless-lav-4x-cheaper): Budget audio solution using Zoom H1 with Tram TR50 lav mic
- [iPhone 4 as audio recorder with external mic: a comparison](https://www.danmccomb.com/iphone-4-as-audio-recorder-with-external-mic-a-comparison): iPhone 4 audio quality comparison with KVconnection external mic
- [My favorite filmmaking tool of 2011: Nissan Leaf](https://www.danmccomb.com/my-favorite-filmmaking-tool-of-2011-nissan-leaf): Nissan Leaf as filmmaking equipment for zero-emissions production

## Documentary Reviews & Analysis

- [The Mystery of Picasso | documentary 40 of 100](https://www.danmccomb.com/the-mystery-of-picasso-documentary-40-of-100): Review of Clouzot's Picasso documentary exploring creative process
- [Czesky Sen (Czech Dream) | documentary 41 of 100](https://www.danmccomb.com/czesky-sen-czech-dream-documentary-41-of-100): Documentary review analyzing Czech hoax film and marketing critique
- [Hoop Dreams | documentary 15 of 100](https://www.danmccomb.com/hoop-dreams-documentary-15-of-100): Hoop Dreams review analyzing three-act structure and story craft
